rates.scope: Standard non-regional text requests at <=272000 input tokens per prompt; no hosted tools; account access unproved

assumptions: Base COPAU illustration: 1 planner x20k/5k, 3 builders x40k/12k, 2 analysts x20k/5k input/output. Applying this mix to B07 journeys is unmeasured and must be replaced by zero-model measured prompt sizes.

O/S add 8 retrieval-followup model turns at40k input/1k billed output; all calls add4k uncached evidence/history input. P adds4k input for each of6calls. These are sensitivity assumptions, not measured arm differences.
All repeated history/schema/context must fit total token ceilings; fail closed rather than assume a free extra turn. Output includes reasoning.
No retries or cache savings assumed. Failed/retried requests consume caps. Longer-context or regional pricing requires re-estimation.
Proposed equal 600k input/100k output ceilings imply USD3 per trial at these rates; 234trials imply702. Add separately approved COPAU10 reservation =>712, neither a new approval nor a forecast.
Compute/hosting/egress/operator labor excluded and must be budgeted separately.
